movies.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
movies.description: Just dropped on digital and shattering records — the Spidey movie everyone is obsessing over.
movies.overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

movies.title: Coyote vs. Acme
movies.description: The movie WB tried to delete is finally here, and Twitter is absolutely cheering.
movies.overview: After Acme products fail him one too many times in his dogged pursuit of the Roadrunner, Wile E. Coyote decides to hire a billboard lawyer to sue the Acme Corporation.

movies.title: Matchbox the Movie
movies.description: Sam Hargrave and John Cena unleash vehicular mayhem. Non-stop, gloriously absurd adrenaline.
movies.overview: When a group of former childhood friends reconnect, their reunion takes a wild turn as they stumble upon a dangerous international plot—and must save the world.

movies.title: Buddy
movies.description: Just dropped three days ago and already terrorizing TikTok feeds. Pure unhinged horror-comedy.
movies.overview: A magical, singing orange unicorn holds his cast hostage in a surreal TV-show dimension, as he becomes more and more demented.

movies.title: Animals
movies.description: Ben Affleck returns to intense thriller territory with Kerry Washington. Tense, smart, and fresh.
movies.overview: When the son of an L.A. mayoral candidate is kidnapped, he and his wife have a few hours to come up with the ransom payment. With most of their money spent on his political campaign, they have to get their hands dirty and expose a side of their lives they never intended to see the light of day.

movies.title: Hope
movies.description: Na Hong-jin's wild sci-fi epic just arrived — cinephiles online are in full meltdown.
movies.overview: In the remote South Korean village of Hope Harbor, police chief Bum-seok and officer Sung-ae are called to investigate a mysterious creature wreaking havoc on the community. But all is not as it seems, and perceptions can be misleading. What begins as ignorance plants the seed of disaster, escalating through human conflict into a tragedy of cosmic proportions.

movies.title: Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender
movies.description: Stunning animation and unmatched nostalgia — fans are calling it a flawless return to form.
movies.overview: Avatar Aang, the world's last Airbender, learns of an ancient power that could save his culture from extinction. With the help of his friends, he embarks on a global quest to find it before it falls into the wrong hands and threatens to upend the peace they sacrificed everything to achieve.

movies.title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
movies.description: Jane Schoenbrun strikes again. The internet's new indie horror obsession of the season.
movies.overview: An ambitious director sets out to revive a faded slasher franchise, but her meeting with the film’s reclusive original star spirals into a terrifying maze of obsession, fear, and blood-soaked delusion.

movies.title: The Love Hypothesis
movies.description: BookTok's Holy Grail finally adapted — your feed won't shut up about this romance.
movies.overview: Olive Smith, a biology PhD candidate, and Dr. Adam Carlsen, a hotshot professor and well-known tyrant, enter into a fake relationship, seeing each of their carefully calculated theories on love get thrown into chaos.

movies.title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba Infinity Castle
movies.description: Mind-blowing animation that literally broke global box offices. You have to experience this spectacle.
movies.overview: The Demon Slayer Corps are drawn into the Infinity Castle, where Tanjiro, Nezuko, and the Hashira face terrifying Upper Rank demons in a desperate fight as the final battle against Muzan Kibutsuji begins.

movies.title: Runner
movies.description: Alan Ritchson and Owen Wilson in a fast-paced romp that just hit digital this week.
movies.overview: A former soldier is thrown into a brutal race against time when a critical medical delivery makes him and his unlikely partner the targets of a ruthless cartel. As the mission spirals into a deadly manhunt, every detour, delay, and bullet pushes them closer to failure. With betrayal closing in from every side, they must survive the chase and deliver their cargo to save the life of a little girl.

movies.title: Onslaught
movies.description: Adam Wingard goes feral with Dan Stevens in an unhinged, blood-soaked genre riot.
movies.overview: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.

movies.title: Insidious: Out of the Further
movies.description: Newest chapter just arrived on digital — turn the lights off for reliable jumpscares.
movies.overview: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.

movies.title: Practical Magic 2
movies.description: Bullock and Kidman reunite! The internet is fiercely divided, so pick a side tonight.
movies.overview: The Owens sisters must confront the dark curse that threatens to unravel their family once and for all.

movies.title: Fall 2: Deadpoint
movies.description: Sweaty palms guaranteed. Vertigo horror that delivers maximum anxiety from start to finish.
movies.overview: On a perilous climb across Thailand's Mount Kwan, two climbers become trapped thousands of feet above the ground, where vertigo-inducing heights, sheer exposure, and impossible odds turn every moment into a fight for survival.

movies.title: Tony
movies.description: Dominic Sessa shines in this witty A24 gem. Film Twitter's latest critical darling.
movies.overview: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.

movies.title: The Rivals of Amziah King
movies.description: Matthew McConaughey delivers his grittiest performance in years. A slow-burn Southern gothic marvel.
movies.overview: Deep within the backwoods of rural Oklahoma, charismatic and musically gifted Amziah King herds a bluegrass-playing band of misfits while overseeing the premier honey-making operation in town. When Amziah’s estranged foster daughter unexpectedly returns, Amziah leaps at the possibility to renew connection and create a family business. But the honey game is ruthless, and Amziah’s rivals threaten to destroy everything he has built.

movies.title: The End of Oak Street
movies.description: David Robert Mitchell crafts an unsettling suburban sci-fi enigma starring Anne Hathaway.
movies.overview: After a mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports their neighborhood to someplace unknown, the Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on them sticking together as they navigate their now unrecognizable surroundings.

movies.title: Don't Say Good Luck
movies.description: Charming, heartfelt, and surprisingly sharp — Sunny Sandler proves she has serious dramatic chops.
movies.overview: Sophie Birenbaum is ready for the spotlight as the lead in her high school musical—until she's suddenly facing more drama at home than on the stage.

movies.title: Batman: Knightfall Part 1: Knightfall
movies.description: The back-breaking DC storyline finally animated with brutal precision. Comic diehards are ecstatic.
movies.overview: Arkham Asylum has been destroyed, and all its inmates have been unleashed upon Gotham City. As Batman races to round up some of his greatest enemies, he is pushed to his physical and mental limits and into a final confrontation with a new threat: the man called Bane!

movies.title: The Furious
movies.description: The year's most jaw-dropping martial arts choreography. Pure kinetic action perfection.
movies.overview: After a criminal network kidnaps Wang Wei's daughter and the corrupt police refuse to assist him, Wei sets out on his own to locate her. Navin, a tenacious journalist whose wife has mysteriously vanished, is his only ally. In this explosive martial arts showdown, the unlikely duo fights the kidnappers ruthlessly driven by a furious vengeance.

movies.title: Obsession
movies.description: The viral box office shocker of the summer that made half a billion dollars.
movies.overview: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.

movies.title: Toy Story 5
movies.description: Pixar pulls heartstrings once again in a billion-dollar blockbuster the whole family adores.
movies.overview: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.

movies.title: The Invite
movies.description: Seth Rogen and Penélope Cruz in an uncomfortably hilarious dinner party gone wrong.
movies.overview: Joe and Angela's marriage is on thin ice. When they invite their enigmatic upstairs neighbors for a dinner party, the night spirals into unexpected places. Have they reignited the spark or lit the match that burns it all down?

movies.title: One Last Shot
movies.description: Scott Adkins doing what he does best: punishing, breathless close-quarters combat.
movies.overview: Navy Seal Jake Harris must stop a team of mercenaries, led by his disillusioned former comrade, from disabling the US missile defense network.

movies.title: The Uprising
movies.description: Paul Greengrass directs Andrew Garfield in a relentlessly tense historical uprising.
movies.overview: As war and plague devastate 14th-century England, a humble peasant ignites a rebellion, uniting an army of commoners to defy the King’s might in a desperate fight for justice and survival.

movies.title: PAW Patrol: The Dino Movie
movies.description: Dinos and pups unite — guaranteed high-energy entertainment to keep the kids enthralled.
movies.overview: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

movies.title: Call My Agent! The Movie
movies.description: The stylish French showbiz satire returns with big laughs, celebrity cameos, and Parisian charm.
movies.overview: Five years after ASK Agency closed, debut director Andréa loses her lead actor just days before filming and reunited with her old team — for better or worse.

movies.title: Mayday
movies.description: Ryan Reynolds brings peak charisma to a breezy, high-altitude popcorn action comedy.
movies.overview: When a U.S. Navy pilot on a top-secret mission during the Cold War gets trapped behind enemy lines, his only chance at survival is to form an alliance with an eccentric ex-KGB agent.

movies.title: UNABOMBER
movies.description: Russell Crowe is deeply unsettling in this chilling psychological hunt. Atmospheric and grim.
movies.overview: Follow Ted Kaczynski's transformation from Harvard prodigy into the infamous Unabomber. Subjected to controversial psychological experiments by Professor Henry Murray, Kaczynski's troubled past resurfaces decades later when his manhunt, led by FBI agent Joanne Miller, brings to light the chilling consequences of ambition and isolation.

movies.title: Drawn Together
movies.description: Ester Expósito smolders in this slick, sensual Spanish thriller packed with twists.
movies.overview: Marfil, daughter of a powerful Spanish businessman, sees her life in New York turned upside down when she is kidnapped and released without explanation. Her father hires Sebastian Moore as bodyguard and, forced to spend every minute together, an inevitable attraction ignites in a world where nothing is as it seems.

movies.title: Mutiny
movies.description: Jason Statham punching his way through maritime conspiracies. Exactly what action fans want.
movies.overview: After witnessing his billionaire boss' murder and being framed for the crime, Cole Reed boards a cargo ship on a one-man crusade to avenge his boss' death only to discover an international conspiracy.

movies.title: One Night Only
movies.description: Monica Barbaro and Callum Turner have sparkling chemistry in this breezy modern rom-com.
movies.overview: Two love-starved strangers crash into each other on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

movies.title: Moana
movies.description: The live-action spectacle sparking fierce online debate. See it and decide for yourself.
movies.overview: Teenage Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.

movies.title: Fuze
movies.description: Aaron Taylor-Johnson and Theo James face off in an explosive, ticking-clock London heist.
movies.overview: An unexploded WWII bomb is discovered on a busy construction site in the centre of London. Chaos ensues as the military and police begin a mass evacuation against a ticking clock.

movies.title: The Runner
movies.description: Gal Gadot sprints through London in a brisk, high-stakes thriller built for speed.
movies.overview: Maia Marten, a brilliant London lawyer, has her life shattered by a single call on her morning run: her son has been taken. To get him back, she must keep running, obey every ruthless command, and trust no one-each second a test of how far a mother will go to save her child.

movies.title: I Want Your Sex
movies.description: Gregg Araki's subversive, stylish comedy gets weird and wild with Olivia Wilde.
movies.overview: When a naive young man becomes the sexual muse for a renowned and provocative artist, his dream job quickly turns dangerous as he is drawn into an obsessive world of power, betrayal, and murder.

movies.title: You+Me - Against the World
movies.description: Dramatic, moody European teen romance tailored specifically for late-night emotional bingeing.
movies.overview: Alma Lancaster, 18, appears to lead a perfect life within a wealthy family who believes she is studying law. In secret, she pursues her true dream: filmmaking. On campus, she meets Vadim Arcadi, 20, a magnetic and solitary rebel with a troubled past. Forced to collaborate on a student film, they clash, grow closer and fall in love — despite themselves. But someone is watching them, determined to tear them apart and expose secrets that could destroy both Alma and Vadim.

movies.title: Ice Cream Man
movies.description: Eli Roth serves up campy, gory, ridiculous B-movie treats for horror midnight crowds.
movies.overview: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.

movies.title: The Whisper Man
movies.description: Robert De Niro anchors a dark, brooding crime mystery perfect for rainy evenings.
movies.overview: When his young son vanishes, a widower enlists help from his estranged father, a retired detective who put away the serial killer now linked to the case.

movies.title: The Secret Woman
movies.description: Claes Bang stars in an icy Nordic noir brimming with tangled secrets and deceit.
movies.overview: After discovering she has a family and a shipping empire, a woman with amnesia returns to a wealthy and seemingly perfect past to uncover why she left.

movies.title: The Last Sunrise
movies.description: Sweeping romantic drama with gorgeous vistas and plenty of sentimental, tear-jerking beats.
movies.overview: Ry, a college student with a chronic illness, escapes to Mallorca for the summer with her mother, where she unexpectedly falls for a local and begins to embrace living in the moment. But as her condition worsens and long-hidden family secrets come to light, everything she has found before summer's end is threatened.

movies.title: Motor City
movies.description: Alan Ritchson brings brute force to a stylish, gritty Detroit revenge crusade.
movies.overview: In 1970s Detroit, John Miller falls for a local gangster's girl and lands in prison for a crime he didn't commit. With his life ruined, Miller plots revenge against the man who took his girl away.

movies.title: Pinocchio: Unstrung
movies.description: Twisted childhood nightmares come alive in this unapologetically trashy indie slasher.
movies.overview: Influenced by a sinister Cricket and created by Geppetto, Pinocchio launches a violent crusade to carve himself into a real boy like his brother James, one piece at a time.

movies.title: Her Private Hell
movies.description: Nicolas Winding Refn unleashes a polarizing, neon-soaked nightmare. Audiences either adore or despise it.
movies.overview: When a mysterious mist engulfs a futuristic metropolis, unleashing a deadly and elusive entity, a troubled young woman searches for her father. Her quest collides with an American GI on a harrowing odyssey to rescue his daughter from Hell.

movies.title: Facing El Chapo
movies.description: Alfonso Herrera stars in a gritty, high-stakes cartel thriller that never lets up.
movies.overview: Two Mexican officers must survive the final hours of their shift after crossing a ruthless cartel boss.

movies.title: Camp Rock 3
movies.description: Pure nostalgic musical comfort food for anyone who grew up on Disney Channel.
movies.overview: When pop group Connect 3 returns to Camp Rock to search for an opening act for their reunion tour, rising tensions and fierce competition among campers test old friendships and spark unexpected romances.

movies.title: Jackass: Best and Last
movies.description: The farewell ride for Johnny Knoxville and crew — painfully hilarious and nostalgic.
movies.overview: The fifth and final installment to Jackass franchise where the crew go on one last insane crusade.

movies.title: Minions & Monsters
movies.description: Gigantic colorful chaos that kids love and parents can effortlessly zone out to.
movies.overview: This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

movies.title: Borgo
movies.description: Hafsia Herzi commands every frame in this tense, realistic French prison thriller.
movies.overview: Melissa is an experienced, exemplary prison guard. But a dangerous spiral is set into motion when she transfers to a Corsican jail, where she accepts help and protection from inmate Saveriu to get her bearings. Upon his release, he contacts Melissa expecting to collect.

movies.title: The Little Sister
movies.description: A quiet, devastating festival gem exploring family trauma with raw emotional honesty.
movies.overview: When Fatima leaves her close-knit suburban family to study philosophy in Paris, she finds herself caught between her religious upbringing and the freedom of student life in the city.

movies.title: Beast Race
movies.description: Fernando Meirelles directs a fast, stylish dystopian racing thriller set in Brazil.
movies.overview: In future Rio de Janeiro, a young leader of the resistance must enter a deadly parkour-inspired competition in order to save his sister's life.

movies.title: The Last House
movies.description: Greta Lee and Wagner Moura navigate a creepy sci-fi home invasion puzzle.
movies.overview: A family suddenly sealed inside their home must work together to survive against dwindling resources and the ominous threat keeping them trapped.

movies.title: Evil Dead Burn
movies.description: Blood, guts, and deadites. A brutal, crowd-pleasing addition to the iconic horror canon.
movies.overview: After her husband's abrupt death, Alice seeks solace with his remaining family — descendants of a leading researcher on demonic possession. As her in-laws transform one by one into creatures that feed on fear, she comes to discover that the vows she took in life survive even in death.

movies.title: Young Washington
movies.description: An earnest, grand-scale historical war drama charting the fiery youth of George Washington.
movies.overview: Before he led a nation, George Washington was a young soldier thrown into a global conflict. With alliances crumbling and war closing in, he must choose who to trust and confront the leader he's becoming.

movies.title: Soulm8te
movies.description: Blumhouse delivers another cautionary AI companion thriller that turns delightfully lethal.
movies.overview: After a ruthless tech giant acquires a small robotics company, a grieving engineer is tasked with testing their new AI companion. But when he attempts to reprogram her to be a truly sentient soulmate, she develops needs of her own—unleashing a relentless spree of precision-engineered mayhem.

movies.title: Nightborn
movies.description: Rupert Grint stars in an eerie Finnish folk horror steeped in creeping dread.
movies.overview: In Finnish forest, Saga and her husband Jon embark on a new chapter as parents. But Saga's joy is overshadowed by a chilling suspicion about their newborn, unbeknownst to Jon, causing a rift as she alone grapples with the disturbing truth.

movies.title: The Devil's Mouth
movies.description: Claustrophobic underwater cave survival horror packed with tense, breathless monster encounters.
movies.overview: A group of college friends' Thailand adventure turns deadly when they become trapped in submerged caves with a dangerous predator. As oxygen runs low, past conflicts emerge in their desperate fight for survival.

movies.title: Leviticus
movies.description: A visually striking Australian queer romance wrapped in chilling, surreal supernatural horror.
movies.overview: Two teenage boys must escape a violent entity that takes the form of the person they desire most:  each other.

movies.title: The Death of Robin Hood
movies.description: Hugh Jackman gives a raw, weathered performance in Michael Sarnoski's dark legend retelling.
movies.overview: Grappling with his past after a life of crime and murder, Robin Hood finds himself gravely injured after a battle he thought would be his last. In the hands of a mysterious woman, he is offered a chance at salvation.
